**Astur v2.8.4** — scrolling columns that peek onto a neighbour monitor stay
reliably behind that monitor's windows instead of periodically popping over
them when focus is on a third screen.

## Download

`astur-windows-x64.zip` holds `astur.exe` and `astur_settings.py`.

## What changed

- **Overhanging scrolling tiles no longer pop over a neighbour monitor's
  windows.** The old periodic sweep checked every previously tracked tile with
  `GetWindowRect` and unconditionally pushed any match to `HWND_BOTTOM`, so
  windows on a neighbour monitor (because of invisible DWM resize borders or
  stale scrolling ownership after being moved) could also be sent to
  `HWND_BOTTOM` and lose an async z-order race when focus was on a third
  monitor. Astur now checks the visible frame (`DWMWA_EXTENDED_FRAME_BOUNDS`)
  against real neighbour-monitor overlap, keeps active scrolling tile ownership
  synced from the manager, and inserts an overhanging tile directly behind the
  neighbour monitor's lowest native window only when it is actually above it.
- **Immediate tuck on focus change and off the hook thread.** The periodic
  overhang sweep moved from each status bar's 1 s timer on the hook thread into
  the manager loop (active only on multi-monitor scrolling setups) and also runs
  immediately when focus leaves an overhanging window.
- **Fixed `astur-resink` worker exit.** The short post-resize resink helper
  thread now exits cleanly once its queue drains instead of staying alive on a
  5 ms poll.

## Notes

- No config key was added or changed, no default changed, and existing config
  files are never rewritten.
